question: Who defeated Prithviraj Chauhan in the second battle of Tarain in 1192 AD?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Muhammad Ghori.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Muhammad Ghori:-**

 
 
• He​** **defeated **Prithviraj Chauhan** in the **second battle of Tarain** in **1192 AD.**
 
• Prithviraj Chauhan was a** Rajput king of the Chauhan dynasty** who ruled from **Delhi and Ajmer.**
 
• Muhammad Ghori was a** Muslim ruler **who invaded India several times and established the **Ghurid dynasty **in parts of India.
 
• The second battle of Tarain was fought between Prithviraj Chauhan and Muhammad Ghori in which** Prithviraj Chauhan was defeated **and captured by Muhammad Ghori.
 
• This battle marked the **end of the Chauhan dynasty **and the beginning of the **Muslim rule **in North India.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Iltutmish** was a **slave dynasty ruler **who succeeded Qutubuddin Aibak.
 
• **Babur **was a **Mughal emperor **who came to power in the 16th century.
 
• **Alauddin Khilji** was a ruler of the** Khilji dynasty** who ruled from Delhi in the 14th century.
